faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central Bank of India for the Regional Office Meerut under advertisement number FY-2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is BC Supervisor, offering contractual employment opportunities for eligible candidates in the banking sector.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for BC Supervisor?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the BC Supervisor position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of offline applications is 23 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach on time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and post it to the designated address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit ranges from 21 to 64 years depending on the category of the applicant and whether they are retired personnel.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for BC Supervisor?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired bank employees with rural banking experience or a graduate with computer knowledge such as MS Office, email, and internet.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Central Bank of India BC Supervisor post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for BC Supervisor?
faq.answer: Salary varies by category, with Category A offering Rs. 15,000/- fixed plus variable components and Category B offering Rs. 12,000/- fixed plus variable components.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the BC Supervisor position involves an interview process conducted by the Central Bank of India.
